heading: INT. MUNICIPAL CLOCK TOWER, MECHANISM ROOM - NIGHT

units.text: INT. MUNICIPAL CLOCK TOWER, MECHANISM ROOM - NIGHT
Brass wheels the size of wagon tires turn in the dark, each tooth polished by a century of oil.
A catwalk skirts the gears.
Below, behind a steel grate, the vault of the Merchants' Exchange sleeps.
SILAS "SPARROW" OKONKWO-REID (40s, silver mustache, gloves the color of old cream) works a hand drill into the vault grate with the patience of a watchman.
Beside him, a canvas roll of tools.
Behind him, the great pendulum swings.
Three and a half minutes, old girl. Don't fail me now.
units.name: SPARROW

units.text: The drill bites through.
He blows the dust away and lifts the grate.
He smiles.
Footsteps on the stair.
Quick, light.
Sparrow freezes, drops the drill, and slides a hand toward his coat.
PATRICIA "PATSY" VELLACOTT (30s, bobbed wig, a pearl-handled revolver at her hip) appears on the landing, unhurried, and gives him a small wave.
Patsy! You were meant to be at the bank.
units.name: SPARROW

units.text: The bank was dull, Sparrow. You were slowing.
units.name: PATSY

units.text: I'm precise. It is a different thing.
units.name: SPARROW

units.text: The watchman makes his round in four minutes.
units.name: PATSY

units.text: Then we have three and a half.
units.name: SPARROW

units.text: She crouches beside the open grate and peers into the dark.
Sparrow, you beautiful old crook.
units.name: PATSY

units.text: Flattery will cost you ten percent.
units.name: SPARROW

units.text: The pendulum swings.
The great clock begins to chime midnight, deafening in the cramped room.
They freeze.
That's not on the schedule!
units.name: PATSY

units.text: Nothing is on the schedule, Patsy!
units.name: SPARROW

units.text: Below, in the vault, a light snaps on.
A heavy door opens.
Boots.
Sparrow, tell me that's the watchman.
units.name: PATSY

units.text: It's the watchman.
units.name: SPARROW

units.text: You're lying.
units.name: PATSY

units.text: Yes.
units.name: SPARROW

units.text: She draws the pearl-handled revolver at last, grinning like a girl at a fair.
Ten percent off the top, then.
units.name: PATSY

units.text: Naturally. Run.
units.name: SPARROW
